header.name: Dragnode Visualization from Product
header.description: Calculates nodes and connectors for use in dragnode visualization by traversing ProductStrategyProcessBOM

data.transform:
const maxVal = $.max.val 
const width = 200
const height = 50
const row = 30
const tier = 120
const color = "#ffc000"
const max = maxVal * width + (maxVal+1) *row
const dNodes = [...$.nodes]
const dWidth = [...$.width]


const data=[]
const connector=[]

for (let i=dNodes.length-1;i>=0; i--) {
 let vWidth = 0   
  for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(dNodes[i])) {

    let iWidth=0
    v.forEach((e,ii)=>{
      data.push({
        "id": e.id,
        "label": e.id.split(":").join("{br}"),
        "color": color,
        "vWidth":vWidth,
        // this calculation is not quite correct!
        "x": width*(vWidth+iWidth+ii) + (vWidth+iWidth+ii+1)*row,//dWidth[i] === maxVal ? ((max/dWidth[i])*(vWidth+ii))+row : max/(dWidth[i]+1)*(vWidth+ii+1),
        "y": height*i/2 + tier * (i+1),
        "shape":"rectangle",
        "width":width,
        "height":height
      })
      
    })
    vWidth+=1
    
    connector.push(...v.map(e=>({  
      "from": k,
      "to": e.id,
      "label": e.qty,
      "color": "#29C3BE",
      "strength": "1",
      "arrowatstart": "0",
      "arrowatend": "1",
      "alpha": "100"
    })))
}
}


const dY = data[data.length-1].y+tier
 data.push({

      "id": Object.keys(dNodes[0])[0],
      "label": Object.keys(dNodes[0])[0].split(":").join("{br}"),
      "color": "#00ff00",
      "x": row,
      "y": dY,
      "shape":"rectangle",
      "width":width,
      "height":height
    
})



return ({
  "data": {
    "data":data,
    "connector":connector
  }
})
